source: PHC Core Rules v1.0 (Classes) + PHC Class Roster, Revision 2

assignment.score: sum of skill points in the class's 3 signature skills (trait bonuses never count)
assignment.eligible: any base class whose score is among the character's two highest distinct scores (ties included)
assignment.tie_rule: player chooses among all eligible classes; nobody is classless
assignment.rank_rule: each rank unlocks the next signature move; rank uses the current signature total
assignment.patrons: prayer is not a class; any character with a patron and Faith 3+ can Pray (see patrons.json)

base.name: Marksman

produces: kills (each death raises the ambient meter)

base.tagline: Guns for most; bows for the quiet ones.

resource.rule: Guns only: single +1, burst +2, auto +4 Heat; -1 to hit per 2 Heat; jam at the limit (2 AP to clear). Bows have no Heat or recoil, are silent, and scale with Raw Power.

moves.name: Fire Discipline
moves.text: Aimed shots add no Heat. Once per turn, a Burst costs 2 AP instead of 3. With a bow, an Aimed shot gets +3 to hit instead of +2.

moves.name: Special Ammo
moves.text: You carry one magazine (or quiver) each of armour-piercing, hollow-point and incendiary, restocked at rest. You can switch ammo type as part of a reload.

moves.name: Killzone
moves.text: When you hold AP for Overwatch, you may hold enough for two shots: one each at the first two enemies that move into your line, both at +2 to hit.

produces: kills (each death raises the ambient meter)

resource.rule: +1 for each tile you move toward a target before a melee attack (max +2 per turn), +1 for each melee hit. Resets to 0 after combat or if you end a turn without attacking.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.text: Spend 1 Momentum: move up to 2 tiles as part of a melee attack. This movement provokes no opportunity attacks.

moves.name: Riposte
moves.text: When a melee attack against you misses, spend 1 Momentum to make a melee attack against the attacker for 0 AP, adding your Counter bonus to hit.

moves.name: Finisher
moves.text: Spend all your Momentum on one melee strike: +20% damage per point spent (up to +100%).

base.name: Defender

produces: kills (each death raises the ambient meter)

base.tagline: Someone has to stand in front.

resource.rule: Gained by Brace. Interpose (reaction): when an adjacent ally is hit, spend 1 Guard to take the hit instead; your armour applies. Guard is lost after combat.

moves.name: Brace
moves.text: Gain Guard equal to 1 + your Durability modifier (max 5) and become Braced (+2 Defense) until you move. Interpose is available whenever you hold Guard.

moves.name: Draw Fire
moves.text: Spend 1 Guard: one enemy you can see must attack you on its next turn, or take -2 to hit anyone else. Bosses and Celestials may ignore it at -2.

moves.name: Reactive Plate
moves.text: Your armour is bot-woven and hardens when struck. When you take damage, spend any Guard: each point cuts the damage by 10. Every 3 Guard you lose this way sheds bots: the ambient meter rises by 2.

produces: kills (each death raises the ambient meter)

resource.rule: Stims, kits and med-drones. Restocked at rest.

moves.name: Triage
moves.text: Heal an adjacent ally 20 x your Healing given multiplier and end their Bleeding. Costs no Supplies. You stabilise a Downed ally for 1 AP.

moves.name: Stim Throw
moves.text: Spend 1 Supply: an ally within 4 tiles heals 30 x your Healing given multiplier and stops Bleeding.

moves.name: Field Surgery
moves.text: Out of combat, spend 1 Supply: treat one arm or leg injury, or clear every Body condition from one ally. Robot medics repair machines the same way.

base.name: Assassin

produces: kills (each death raises the ambient meter)

base.tagline: Stealth, poison, and the patience to wait for the right moment.

resource.rule: Up to 3 enemies Marked at once. Toxin doses: 2 + floor(ingenuity / 3), restocked at rest.

moves.name: Mark
moves.text: Mark an enemy you can see: it becomes Marked (your squad gets +1 to hit it; it can't become Hidden).

moves.name: Toxin
moves.text: Spend 1 toxin dose to coat a blade, dart or arrow. Your next hit also inflicts Weakened, Slowed or Bleeding (your choice; Body save).

moves.name: Execution
moves.text: Your hit on a Marked enemy at or below a quarter of its max HP kills it outright. Bosses and Celestials are immune.

base.name: Mage

produces: mana (Vent raises the ambient meter by the Flux vented)

base.tagline: FIRE - SEEK - SPREAD, at range, as often as the cores hold out.

resource.shared_rule: Every word drawn adds 1 Flux. Above 6 the Evoker overloads (10 damage per Flux over 6, Evoker locks 1 turn, all Flux bursts into the air). Vent (1 AP) dumps all Flux into the air: meter + Flux vented.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.text: The 2-charge damage words (FIRE, FREEZE, SHOCK, STONE and ACID) cost 1 charge less each; each glyph still costs at least 1. SPARK and GALE already cost 1.

moves.name: Overcharge
moves.text: Once per combat, add one word to a spell beyond your Max Sigil words (never past 4 glyphs), for no charge and no AP. It still adds Flux.

moves.name: Payload
moves.text: Evoke a Line with double area: a SPREAD radius or a PUSH cone's length doubles (both, if it has both), and a spell with neither gets one more missile, as one more TWICE. The Evoke adds Flux equal to its glyph count. A STAY, WAIT or WATCH spell can't carry it.

produces: mana (Vent raises the ambient meter by the Flux vented)

resource.shared_rule: Every word drawn adds 1 Flux. Above 6 the Evoker overloads (10 damage per Flux over 6, Evoker locks 1 turn, all Flux bursts into the air). Vent (1 AP) dumps all Flux into the air: meter + Flux vented.

moves.name: Raise Cover
moves.text: You can Evoke a lone STAY glyph with no Subject as a cover rune, from a tile next to it: full cover on its tile and one tile next to it for 2 rounds + your Sigil duration bonus.

moves.name: Ward
moves.text: Spend 1-3 charge: an ally within 6 tiles gains a shield of 10 x charge spent x your Healing given multiplier. Adds 1 Flux per charge.

moves.name: Seal
moves.text: Spend 2 charge: a 3x3-tile zone in range where, for 2 rounds, enemy Sigils cost double charge and enemy Soul spells cost double MP.

base.name: Scribe

produces: mana (Vent raises the ambient meter by the Flux vented)

base.tagline: Most sigils are written in a hurry. A Scribe's are written to last.

resource.shared_rule: Every word drawn adds 1 Flux. Above 6 the Evoker overloads (10 damage per Flux over 6, Evoker locks 1 turn, all Flux bursts into the air). Vent (1 AP) dumps all Flux into the air: meter + Flux vented.

moves.name: Quicken
moves.text: Spend 1 charge: an ally within 6 tiles gets +1 AP on their next turn (AP ceiling applies). On the area map the +1 lands on this overworld round's AP.

moves.name: Inscribe Gear
moves.text: Spend 2 charge (or do it out of combat): write a sigil onto an ally's weapon (+10% damage) or torso armour (+5 armour value) until the next rest. One inscription per item.

moves.name: Stored Spell
moves.text: Out of combat, write a whole Sigil spell (its words) onto an object, paying its charge and Flux now. Anyone can trigger it later for 1 AP: it goes off from the object's tile with its own Reach, all around. It fades at the next rest. You can keep a number of stored spells equal to your Rumination modifier.

produces: mana (Vent raises the ambient meter by the Flux vented)

resource.shared_rule: Every word drawn adds 1 Flux. Above 6 the Evoker overloads (10 damage per Flux over 6, Evoker locks 1 turn, all Flux bursts into the air). Vent (1 AP) dumps all Flux into the air: meter + Flux vented.

moves.name: Bind
moves.text: The BIND word costs 1 charge less, and its Body save is against 14 + your debuff strength instead of 12.

moves.name: Blind and Slow
moves.text: You learn the condition words BLIND, SLOW and MUDDLE (Left Brain Debuff), if you don't already know them; each costs 1 charge less.

moves.name: Rewrite
moves.text: Spend 3 charge: one buff or helpful state on an enemy in range flips into its opposite until it ends (Braced becomes Prone, +2 to hit becomes -2, a shield becomes damage). Brain save.

effects.note: Pick the opposite of exotic buffs.

base.name: Channeler
base.tagline: Imagine the storm. The world agrees.

resource.shared_rule: Rules 1.5 (Outburst 2.0): each Begin or cast adds 1 Strain (2 in Flooded air), and each turn you hold an Outburst 1 more. Strain falls by 1 at the start of every one of your turns, and by calming the heart (a still turn, your first weapon attack or first heal, stim, shield or cleanse given each turn, letting a held Outburst go, Steady the heart). Over the limit (3 + floor(Will Power / 2)) each point burns 8 true damage at the end of your turn; at 3 over the Mana Short is automatic (no roll): Stunned, and a held Outburst goes off wild. Resets after combat. Crystallise (3 AP, meter >= 10): meter -10, make one standard core.

moves.name: Shape
moves.text: Your first Pump each turn that would cost AP is free, while the held Outburst is a Damage design (rules 1.5; Empathy's free Pumps go first).

moves.name: Storm Front
moves.text: Once per turn, for +10 MP at Begin: once a Damage Bolt or Lance has landed, it arcs on to up to 2 more enemies within 2 tiles of the first creature it hit, at the stage reached, one roll each, with its tone's rider (rules 1.5; area shapes can't take it).

moves.name: Heart Surge
moves.text: Once per turn, a toggle on a Release (or a snap cast): it fires one stage higher (past stage 4: x2.6; a snap: stage 1), for double the Strain: the Begin's Strain again once it lands (rules 1.5).

base.name: Guardian
base.tagline: If you can imagine it whole, it stays whole.

resource.shared_rule: Rules 1.5 (Outburst 2.0): each Begin or cast adds 1 Strain (2 in Flooded air), and each turn you hold an Outburst 1 more. Strain falls by 1 at the start of every one of your turns, and by calming the heart (a still turn, your first weapon attack or first heal, stim, shield or cleanse given each turn, letting a held Outburst go, Steady the heart). Over the limit (3 + floor(Will Power / 2)) each point burns 8 true damage at the end of your turn; at 3 over the Mana Short is automatic (no roll): Stunned, and a held Outburst goes off wild. Resets after combat. Crystallise (3 AP, meter >= 10): meter -10, make one standard core.

moves.name: Will Shield
moves.text: A Buff-school cast (Soul cast AP, 20 MP base): an ally in range gains a shield of 30 x your Healing given multiplier until the end of combat.

moves.name: Drink It In
moves.text: When an enemy spell hits a shield you made, its bots feed your Emanator: gain MP equal to the spell's MP cost, or 10 per Sigil word, up to your Max MP.

moves.name: Sanctuary
moves.text: Soul cast AP, 60 MP, +1 extra Strain: a 3x3-tile zone where allies take half damage until your next turn (your own heart's burn isn't halved).

base.name: Bard
base.tagline: Your belief makes the squad better than it is.

resource.shared_rule: Rules 1.5 (Outburst 2.0): each Begin or cast adds 1 Strain (2 in Flooded air), and each turn you hold an Outburst 1 more. Strain falls by 1 at the start of every one of your turns, and by calming the heart (a still turn, your first weapon attack or first heal, stim, shield or cleanse given each turn, letting a held Outburst go, Steady the heart). Over the limit (3 + floor(Will Power / 2)) each point burns 8 true damage at the end of your turn; at 3 over the Mana Short is automatic (no roll): Stunned, and a held Outburst goes off wild. Resets after combat. Crystallise (3 AP, meter >= 10): meter -10, make one standard core.

moves.name: Inspire
moves.text: Spend 10 MP: an ally within 6 tiles gets +2 on their next roll. Adds no Strain.

moves.name: Mend
moves.text: A Buff-school cast that heals 40 x your Healing given multiplier x the ambient Healing multiplier: stronger in rich air.

moves.name: Gift
moves.text: Out of combat, hand an ally one of your ready designs. They cast it once for 3 AP (Begin and Release), on your MP and your Strain; it goes off at stage 1 (rules 1.5).

base.name: Hexer
base.tagline: The bots can build a fireball. They can also build what someone fears most.

resource.shared_rule: Rules 1.5 (Outburst 2.0): each Begin or cast adds 1 Strain (2 in Flooded air), and each turn you hold an Outburst 1 more. Strain falls by 1 at the start of every one of your turns, and by calming the heart (a still turn, your first weapon attack or first heal, stim, shield or cleanse given each turn, letting a held Outburst go, Steady the heart). Over the limit (3 + floor(Will Power / 2)) each point burns 8 true damage at the end of your turn; at 3 over the Mana Short is automatic (no roll): Stunned, and a held Outburst goes off wild. Resets after combat. Crystallise (3 AP, meter >= 10): meter -10, make one standard core.

moves.name: Dread
moves.text: Status-school spells that inflict Fear cost 5 MP less, and Fear you inflict lasts 1 extra round.

moves.name: Mind Fog
moves.text: Your Status spells can inflict a Left or Right Brain Debuff with +2 to the save TN.

moves.name: Puppet
moves.text: Soul cast AP, 60 MP, Heart save: you choose the target's next action. It can't be made to harm itself directly. Bosses roll the save twice and keep the better.

effects.note: Rule on what counts as harming itself.

advanced.name: Gunslinger
advanced.summary: Gunplay with a swordsman's footwork.

moves.name: The Draw
moves.text: Before the first initiative turn of a combat, fire one single shot with a pistol or revolver for 0 AP.

moves.name: Six for Six
moves.text: Fire up to six single shots from a pistol or revolver at targets within 4 tiles. Recoil and Heat apply to each.

moves.name: Called Shot
moves.text: Name head, arm or leg and shoot at -2. On a hit, apply that injury result (head: Dazed; arm: -2 to attacks with it; leg: half Movement) without needing a critical.

advanced.name: Hellraiser Heavy
advanced.summary: Emplaced, belt-fed fire that makes ground impossible to stand on.

moves.name: Emplace
moves.text: Become Emplaced: heavy weapons lose their unemplaced penalty, you ignore recoil, and you gain +5 armour until you move.

moves.name: Suppression
moves.text: While Emplaced, fire full auto into a 3x3-tile area. Until your next turn, any enemy there that moves or attacks takes one attack roll from you and is Pinned on a hit (Body save).

moves.name: Belt Discipline
moves.text: While Emplaced, your weapon's Heat limit is +6 and it loses 4 Heat at the start of your turn instead of 2.

advanced.name: CCEC Ballistician
advanced.summary: Ballistics and weak points; one shot closes a case.

moves.name: Case File
moves.text: Analyze costs 1 AP and also Marks the target.

moves.name: Weak Point
moves.text: Your Aimed shots against a Marked target ignore armour and are critical on a natural 18-20.

moves.name: One Shot
moves.text: If you haven't moved this turn, an Aimed shot at a Marked target deals triple damage.

advanced.name: Banner Dancer
advanced.summary: Armourless skirmisher whose bot-thread banners shield and rally allies.

moves.name: Banner Thread
moves.text: With no torso armour (Class 0) you get +2 Defense and +1 Movement.

moves.name: Rally Banner
moves.text: Plant a banner. Allies who start their turn within 2 tiles of it gain a 10-point shield (doesn't stack) while you stay within 3 tiles of it.

moves.name: Sweep
moves.text: Spend 3 Momentum: move up to 3 tiles. Make one melee attack against each enemy you pass adjacent to; each ally you pass heals 10.

advanced.name: RTC Contractor
advanced.summary: Credit buys supply drops, strikes and extractions.

moves.name: Supply Drop
moves.text: Spend 100 credits: next round a crate lands within 6 tiles. Anyone adjacent can take 1 Supply or one magazine from it (1 AP).

moves.name: Strike Call
moves.text: Spend 300 credits: at the start of your next turn, a 3x3-tile area takes 50 Physical damage. Anyone inside can spend their reaction to move 1 tile.

effects.note: No strikes where the Company has no signal.

moves.name: Extraction
moves.text: Spend 500 credits: a Company flyer lifts the squad out after 2 rounds.

effects.note: Decide where the flyer can land and what follows.

advanced.name: Blade Scribe
advanced.summary: Evoker blades: each sword form draws a sigil.

moves.name: Sword Form
moves.text: Each melee attack can also draw one Sigil glyph on your own tile for no extra AP. It still costs charge and adds Flux.

moves.name: Edge Sigil
moves.text: A damage word drawn through Sword Form adds its element damage to that hit as Elemental damage.

moves.name: Three-Cut Script
moves.text: Three melee attacks, each drawing one word; the three words resolve as one spell after the third cut.

advanced.name: Siege Engineer
advanced.summary: Deployable cover and turrets reinforced with STAY cover runes.

moves.name: Deploy Cover
moves.text: Place a portable barricade on an adjacent tile: half cover, 40 HP. Draw a STAY glyph on a tile next to it to make it full cover.

moves.name: Sentry Turret
moves.text: Spend 2 charge: deploy a turret (40 HP, Defense 10) that fires once per round at the nearest enemy (+4 to hit, 20 damage). One at a time.

moves.name: Bulwark Line
moves.text: Until your next turn, all cover within 3 tiles counts as full cover and gains 20 HP.

advanced.name: Spellslinger
advanced.summary: Sigils inscribed on rounds: every magazine carries a stored spell.

moves.name: Inscribed Rounds
moves.text: Out of combat, spend 1 charge per round to inscribe up to 6 rounds with a one-word effect (an element or a condition word).

moves.name: Spell Magazine
moves.text: Store a full Sigil spell in a magazine. The first hit after loading it triggers the spell at the target.

moves.name: Ricochet Glyph
moves.text: When a shot misses, it can glance to another target within 4 tiles of the first: roll again at -2.

advanced.name: Storm Hand
advanced.summary: One element infused into a weapon through an Emanator gauntlet; melee hits charge it and carry the element's rider.

moves.name: Gauntlet Infusion
moves.text: Choose one element at each rest (fire, freeze, shock or spark). Your melee hits deal +10 Elemental damage of it for 5 MP a hit (no Strain) and carry its stage-1 rider, with its effect and sound: Fire sets Burning 1 round on a critical, else +5 more; Shock chains to one enemy next to the target for half; Freeze Slows (Body save); Spark gives +1 AP on a kill (rules 1.5).

moves.name: Charged by Battle
moves.text: Each melee hit you land gives 1 Charge (max 3). Charges fade after combat (rules 1.5: battle, not kills).

moves.name: Discharge
moves.text: Spend all Charges with a melee hit: everyone adjacent to the target takes 20 Elemental damage per Charge and the infused element's rider at stage N (N = the Charges spent; the Outburst tone table: fire Fire, shock Storm, freeze Frost; spark has none), with full effects and screen shake (rules 1.5).

advanced.name: Adamantile Knight
advanced.summary: Plate that hardens when struck and turns shed bots into shields for allies.

moves.name: Adamantile Plate
moves.text: When Reactive Plate sheds bots, an adjacent ally of your choice gains a shield of 10 per Guard you lost.

moves.name: Bulwark of Will
moves.text: Brace also gives you a shield of 20 x your Healing given multiplier.

moves.name: Unbroken
moves.text: The first time in a combat you would drop to 0 HP, drop to 1 instead and gain 3 Guard.

advanced.name: Shade
advanced.summary: Silent kills that leave fear behind; marked targets see their nightmares.

moves.name: Silent Kill
moves.text: A kill from Hidden doesn't reveal you.

moves.name: Nightmare Mark
moves.text: Enemies you Mark make a Heart save at the start of each of their turns or are Afraid of you (Fear) that turn.

moves.name: Lingering Dread
moves.text: When you kill, every enemy within 3 tiles who saw it makes a Heart save or becomes Shaken.

advanced.name: Lumeri Templar
advanced.summary: The paladin: Blessings fired as shells, a patron watching, Judgement.

moves.name: Blessed Shells
moves.text: When you Pray successfully, you can load the Blessing into a scattergun shell or your weapon instead. On your next hit it resolves at the target (if harmful) or on allies adjacent to the target (if helpful).

moves.name: Under the Eye
moves.text: While you are Witnessed, allies within 3 tiles also get +2 on actions on your patron's theme.

moves.name: Judgement
moves.text: Spend 3 Devotion: a melee or scattergun attack dealing damage x (1 + your Blessing power).

advanced.name: Stroke Gambler
advanced.summary: Random half-sigils stitched into whole spells.

moves.name: Half-Sigil
moves.text: Draw a random word from those you know (the engine rolls) as a half-glyph on your own tile. It costs 1 charge and adds Flux.

moves.name: Stitch
moves.text: Cast a spell built only from Half-Sigils and roll a d20: 1-5 it hits you or your nearest ally instead; 16-20 its damage doubles.

moves.name: House Edge
moves.text: Once per combat, reroll a Stitch roll.

advanced.name: Devoted
advanced.summary: A few spells, loved and boosted beyond anyone else's.

moves.name: Beloved Spells
moves.text: Choose up to 3 ready designs as Beloved. They cost 30% less MP and get +1 module slot.

moves.name: Heart's Own
moves.text: While you Begin or hold a Beloved spell, your Strain limit is 2 higher: the burn and the Mana Short count from it (rules 1.5).

moves.name: Love Made Manifest
moves.text: Once per combat, a Beloved Outburst Begins at stage 4: the heart full at once (rules 1.5).

advanced.name: Circuit Mage
advanced.tutor: The Institute of Forgotten Knowledge, in secret
advanced.summary: Vents and crystallises in one body: the only caster who needs nobody's cores.

requires.tutor: The Institute of Forgotten Knowledge, in secret

moves.name: Closed Loop
moves.text: When you Vent, your own Emanator takes the Flux as 10 MP per Flux instead of the air.

moves.name: Self-Crystallise
moves.text: Crystallise from your own MP: spend 100 MP to make a standard core, ignoring the meter.

moves.name: Fusion
moves.text: Cast a spell that joins Sigil words that aren't Subjects (Reach, Delivery, Burst, Filter) to a Soul school: each creature the Sigil reaches takes the Outburst as a Bolt, at stage 0 (x0.6) or at the stage you held it to. Pay both costs, +1 Strain and +2 Flux. Celestials notice.

effects.note: Each Fusion in sight of the world is a Knowing risk: decide whether a Celestial takes an interest.

advanced.name: Glyph Mason
advanced.summary: A mason's-chisel Evoker: one Keystone glyph that never fades, and the fight is planned around it.

moves.name: Keystone
moves.text: Cut a glyph on your own tile instead of drawing it (2 AP + 1 standard core): it never fades, can't be scuffed, doesn't count toward your glyph limit and survives being Evoked. One at a time; it stays in that zone until you cut another.

moves.name: Survey
moves.text: You and your allies can Evoke a Line that holds your Keystone from up to 2 tiles away, and it costs 1 charge less to fire.

moves.name: Foundation
moves.text: Once per scene: this turn, glyphs you draw within 2 tiles of your Keystone cost 0 AP.

advanced.name: Grand Sigilist
advanced.summary: A staff Evoker: one word enlarged into a Grand form over the battlefield, and bare hands while the staff stands planted.

moves.name: Enlarge
moves.text: Once per combat (3 AP + 3 charge): plant the staff and enlarge one word you know into its Grand form (sigils.json, grand) over radius 2 around the staff for 3 rounds + duration bonus. While planted you can't draw or Evoke; pulling it out (1 AP, adjacent) ends it.

moves.name: Empty Hand
moves.text: With empty hands, unarmed strikes deal 20 Physical for 2 AP, and you get +2 Defense.

moves.name: Earthed
moves.text: Inside your own Grand form you ignore its harm, and your unarmed strikes carry its element.

advanced.name: Heartfed
advanced.summary: Every feeling in the room is fuel: Rage, Grief, Fear and Devotion fill four gauges that feed the Outbursts keyed to them.

moves.name: Four Hearts
moves.text: Four gauges, 0-5: Rage (+1 per 20 damage you take), Grief (+2 when an ally is Downed, +5 when one dies), Fear (+1 when a fight with an Elite or Boss starts, +2 when you're Shaken), Devotion (+1 when an ally heals or buffs you). Each design is keyed to one.

moves.name: Fed
moves.text: Your Outbursts cost 10% less MP per point in their key gauge. While you hold one, spend 1 point of its gauge for a Pump that costs no AP (2 a turn). Releasing it empties that gauge (rules 1.5).

moves.name: Overflow
moves.text: Once per scene, when a gauge reaches 5, your next Outburst keyed to it Begins at stage 2 (the held stage itself) with no Strain.

advanced.name: Heartbinder
advanced.summary: Heart links: cast from a linked ally's place, share their wounds, heal through the bond.

moves.name: Link
moves.text: Bind your heart to one ally within 6 tiles (two from Will Power 5) for the scene, or until you're Downed.

moves.name: Through
moves.text: Snap-cast (Begin and Release, x0.6) or Release your held Outburst from a linked ally's position: range, sight and the shape run from their tile. Buffs you receive reach them at half.

moves.name: Share
moves.text: When a linked ally takes damage, take up to half of it yourself. Strain that would take a linked ally over their limit comes to you instead (as far as your limit allows); Take their Strain (1 AP, once a turn) moves up to 2. Heals you send through a link are x1.25. If a linked ally is Downed, you take 2 Strain (rules 1.5).

effects.when: a linked ally's Strain would pass their limit; action take_strain moves 2

advanced.name: Vessel
advanced.summary: No Outbursts: the heart charges the body instead, then lets it all go in one strike.

moves.name: Inner Charge
moves.text: Begin's 2 AP, 20 MP, 1 Strain: hold a body form like an Outburst. It starts at stage 1 and reads the 1.5 stage table (x1, x1.4, x1.8, x2.2), swells a stage each turn (1 Strain each) and can be Pumped (1 AP, or an Empathy free Pump). Iron (armour +10), Surge (melee and unarmed damage +15), Swift (+2 Movement), Pain to Power (+1 AP next turn per 20 damage taken, up to +2), Steady (no Prone or push; +2 Body saves), Heartbeat (heal 10 at turn start). At most 2 forms at once, whatever your Will Power.

moves.name: Release
moves.text: End every form at once in one strike (free with a melee hit): +15 Soul damage x each form's stage multiplier, summed.

moves.name: Empty Hand
moves.text: Unarmed strikes deal 20 Physical for 2 AP. The Vessel can't design or cast Outbursts.

advanced.name: Twinbound
advanced.summary: Your soul's twin in the upper realm leans through: a companion with its own turn and three built-in Outbursts.

moves.name: Manifest
moves.text: Out of combat, once: design your Twin, its look (a portrait card) and three built-in Outbursts from schools and modules you know. They are fixed.

moves.name: Call
moves.text: The Twin appears within 3 tiles and takes its own turn after yours with 4 AP: move, work its built-in Outbursts with its own heart (Begin, Pump, hold and Release at its own stage; your MP, your Strain; you and it don't resonate with each other) or Guard you. HP 50% of yours, your Defense, Movement 1.5, your Will Power; at most 6 tiles from you. On the area map the twin is a token with its own 4 AP a round (moves only) and joins a fight opened there as the called twin.

moves.name: Bond
moves.text: If the Twin drops to 0 HP it vanishes and you take 3 Strain; call it again next scene. In game text it is only ever the twin, and it never speaks of the upper realm.
